Looking for the best Bootstrap dashboard examples and templates? We’ve curated a comprehensive collection of both free and premium solutions trusted by developers worldwide.

From open-source projects with thousands of GitHub stars to premium templates with extensive support, find the perfect Bootstrap admin dashboard for your next project.

Each template has been selected based on quality, community support, regular updates, and real-world usage in production environments.

Free Bootstrap Dashboard Templates

1. AdminLTE

⭐ 43.8k GitHub Stars

Why we like it: The most popular open-source admin dashboard with unmatched community support and extensive plugin ecosystem.

AdminLTE is the gold standard for Bootstrap admin templates. With over 43,000 GitHub stars, it offers a comprehensive solution including pre-built pages, reusable components, and plugins. Perfect for rapid prototyping and production-ready applications, it includes multiple dashboard variations, form examples, tables, charts, and calendar integrations.

Download Preview

2. CoreUI Free

⭐ 12k GitHub Stars

Why we like it: Enterprise-grade components with TypeScript support and professional documentation rivaling premium templates.

CoreUI Free brings professional-grade admin dashboard capabilities without the price tag. Built on Bootstrap 5, it includes 50+ components, multiple layout options, and excellent TypeScript support. The template offers dark mode, RTL support, and seamless integration with popular frameworks like React, Vue, and Angular.

Download Preview

3. Tabler

⭐ 38.2k GitHub Stars

Why we like it: Modern, clean design with 100+ responsive components and exceptional performance optimization.

Tabler stands out with its premium-quality design despite being completely free. Featuring over 100 responsive components, 20+ page examples, and extensive customization options, it’s perfect for modern web applications. The template includes advanced form elements, data tables, charts, and a comprehensive icon library.

Download Preview

4. SB Admin 2

⭐ 9.7k GitHub Stars

Why we like it: Beginner-friendly with excellent documentation and perfect for small to medium projects.

SB Admin 2 by Start Bootstrap provides a solid foundation for admin interfaces. While simpler than some alternatives, it excels in ease of use and clean code structure. Includes Chart.js integration, custom utility classes, and responsive sidebar navigation. Ideal for developers new to admin templates or projects with straightforward requirements.

Download Preview

5. Gentelella

⭐ 21k GitHub Stars

Why we like it: Feature-rich with 30+ plugins pre-integrated and production-ready e-commerce components.

Gentelella Admin is a comprehensive Bootstrap admin template with extensive third-party plugin integration. It includes e-commerce layouts, detailed form wizards, calendar functionality, and social media widgets. The template offers multiple color schemes and has been battle-tested in numerous production environments.

Download Preview

Premium Bootstrap Dashboard Templates

For projects requiring advanced features, dedicated support, and regular updates, these premium templates offer exceptional value:

6. Metronic

💎 117,000+ Sales • $49

Why we like it: The world’s #1 selling Bootstrap admin template with unmatched flexibility supporting 9+ frameworks and lifetime updates.

Metronic stands as the most comprehensive admin dashboard solution with over 150 pages, 60+ components, and 1000+ UI elements. Supporting Bootstrap 5, Tailwind CSS, React, Vue, Angular, Laravel, and more, it includes 50+ unique hand-crafted demos. Regular updates since 2013 have made it the trusted choice for over 100,000 developers worldwide.

Get Template Live Preview

7. Vuexy

💎 23,000+ Sales • $42

Why we like it: The most developer-friendly admin template with atomic design system and free lifetime updates across all frameworks.

Vuexy delivers the perfect blend of modern design and technical excellence with 30+ pages, 60+ UI components, 5 conceptual dashboards, and 10 pre-built applications. Supporting Bootstrap 5, Vue.js, React, Laravel, ASP.NET, and Django, it follows the highest industry standards.

Get Template Live Preview

8. Frest

💎 7,500+ Sales • $35

Why we like it: Clean and minimal Bootstrap 5 design with exceptional performance and both vertical and horizontal layouts.

Frest represents the pinnacle of minimalist admin design, built on Bootstrap 5 with meticulous attention to detail. Features include light/dark modes, RTL support, and developer-friendly architecture. The template includes multiple dashboard variations and extensive chart libraries.

Get Template Live Preview

9. Limitless

💎 19,000+ Sales • $42

Why we like it: Massive web application kit with 1000+ pages and components, perfect for large-scale enterprise applications.

Limitless lives up to its name with an extensive collection of 1000+ pages, 1000+ components, and countless UI elements. Based on Bootstrap framework, it offers 5 layout variations, 2 themes, and 9 page-layouts for navbar and sidebar combinations.

Get Template Live Preview

10. SmartAdmin

💎 18,500+ Sales • $35

Why we like it: WebApp theme with AI-powered features and extensive customization including 7 skins and 8 layouts.

SmartAdmin WebApp goes beyond traditional admin templates with built-in AI components and smart features. It includes multiple dashboards, extensive app layouts, and comprehensive app settings with advanced features like voice command integration.

Get Template Live Preview

11. CoreUI PRO

💎 55M+ Downloads • $79

Why we like it: Enterprise-grade components library trusted by major corporations with exceptional documentation and support.

CoreUI PRO represents the professional version of the popular open-source framework. Built specifically for enterprise applications, it includes advanced components, priority support, and regular security updates with seamless integration across modern frameworks.

Get Template Live Preview

12. Able Pro

💎 12,000+ Sales • $49

Why we like it: Feature-rich template with 7+ dashboard designs and support for 10+ technologies including CodeIgniter and .NET.

Able Pro delivers comprehensive functionality across multiple technology stacks. With Bootstrap 5 at its core, it extends to React, Vue, Angular, CodeIgniter, .NET, and more, including 7+ unique dashboards and 200+ UI components.

Get Template Live Preview

13. Materialize

💎 21,000+ Sales • $35

Why we like it: Material Design excellence with multi-framework support and Google’s design principles perfectly implemented.

Materialize brings Google’s Material Design to life as the #1 selling material admin template. Supporting Bootstrap 5, Vuetify, MUI, and Tailwind CSS, it ensures consistent Material Design implementation with advanced animations.

Get Template Live Preview

14. Argon Dashboard PRO

💎 15,000+ Customers • $149

Why we like it: Creative Tim’s premium offering with 200+ components and exceptional design quality recognized industry-wide.

Argon Dashboard PRO sets the standard for modern admin interfaces. Built on Bootstrap 5, it includes 200+ handcrafted components, 25+ customized plugins, and advanced components like vector maps and sophisticated form elements.

Get Template Live Preview

15. OneUI

💎 8,500+ Sales • $34

Why we like it: Super flexible Bootstrap 5 template with Laravel 12 starter kit and comprehensive UI framework.

OneUI combines flexibility with power, offering a complete Bootstrap 5 admin dashboard and UI framework. The template includes Laravel 12 starter kit, Vue.js edition, and extensive customization options with multiple color themes.

Get Template Live Preview

16. Sneat

💎 6,000+ Sales • $39

Why we like it: Most customizable Bootstrap 5 template with developer-first approach and beautiful modern aesthetics.

Sneat represents the next generation of admin templates with its developer-first philosophy. Built on Bootstrap 5, it offers unparalleled customization capabilities, modern design language, and comprehensive documentation with video tutorials.

Get Template Live Preview

17. Dashcode

💎 3,500+ Sales • $39

Why we like it: Ultimate development tool for React, Vue 3, and Tailwind with five conceptual dashboards out of the box.

Dashcode stands out as the most powerful solution for modern web development. Combining Bootstrap 5 with React, Vue 3, and Tailwind CSS options, it includes 5 conceptual dashboards and 6 pre-built applications with modular architecture.

Get Template Live Preview

Choosing the Right Bootstrap Dashboard Template

When selecting a Bootstrap dashboard template, consider your project requirements, budget, and long-term maintenance needs. Free templates are perfect for learning, prototypes, and smaller projects, while premium templates offer advanced features, dedicated support, and regular updates for production applications.

All templates listed above are actively maintained, well-documented, and trusted by thousands of developers worldwide.
